name: Iron Blast
look: a sleek black armoured Mewtwo with a blade-crested helmet and pink visor, white shoulder pads dripping glowing pink plasma, round white thigh plates, a pink-orb fist and a black tail glowing pink at its end
entry: A Pokémon resembling Mewtwo, recorded in a classified report about a weapon built to surpass it. The plasma that drips from its armour is pure psychic power, and the orb on its fist can level a mountain.
how: Wild: very rare in End cities.
